top3.content:
# Teach with the Library

Harvard Library provides course support to help students navigate the Library and find the materials they need.

## General library instruction

Librarians can create an instruction session for a particular class or topic. A session can take place in a library space, in the class's usual room, or remotely. Faculty can arrange it by contacting their library liaison or submitting a request.

# Librarians for First-Year Students

Harvard assigns dedicated First-Year Librarians to help first-year students use the Library.

## Support available

First-Year Librarians serve as personal library contacts for first-year students. They provide guidance, consultations and referrals while students begin exploring research interests and writing research papers for their classes.

top3.content:
Available material normally arrives within four business days and must be collected in person. The borrower is notified by email. A BorrowDirect loan lasts 16 weeks and cannot be renewed. Pending requests appear in the BorrowDirect account, while checked-out items appear in HOLLIS. BorrowDirect material may be returned to any Harvard library.

## Eligible material

A Libby loan lasts 14 days. A user may borrow no more than three books at once and may place up to five books on hold.

Users can search for a title with the magnifying-glass icon or browse with the building icon. A requested addition to the Farnsworth collection should be submitted as a Purchase Request with **Online** selected as the format and **Farnsworth Room** selected as the library.

Regular materials are generally lent for a semester, although the item record in HOLLIS gives the specific loan period and technology loans are shorter. If no other user requests a regular loan item, its loan period is automatically renewed up to five times. Circulating material may be returned to any Harvard library. Regular loans can be recalled at the Library's discretion, with notice sent by email.
